text_block_list.text:
During training, Rice Shower crouched down
and curled up into a ball...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah... Rice is okay... so
I have to do my best for the next race...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I run in lots of races...
because I want to make everyone happy...

It seems I'm pushing her too hard.
I might need to rethink her upcoming race schedule...
